Explicit total-character-level scaling supplies 2 beams at 5,3 at 11,4 at 17; declare each target before its attack, each must be perceived within 60 ft/line of effect. Different legal recipients allowed; each beam is a separate hit/damage event. Ordinary critical doubles that beam’s die only. No CHA damage modifier, pushing or automatic extra effect. Normal cantrip RP 0, actual independent costs, Dissonance/Refrain and interruption apply once for the cast, not once per beam. No generic ordinary catalog access or Warlock class is inferred.
